description: Returns every book with its code, chapter count, the editions it exists in and its URL, and the list of editions. The whole list comes back in one piece. Use when the user asks what books, editions or book codes are available.

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: list_books
title: List the books
